checks.name: phase_f_dsp_files_exist
command: test -f Source/DSP/PitchDetector.h && test -f Source/DSP/PitchDetector.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/NoteFollower.h && test -f Source/DSP/NoteFollower.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/ParametricBand.h && test -f Source/DSP/ParametricBand.cpp && test -f tests/PitchTrackingTests.cpp

checks.name: cmake_lists_lists_phase_f_sources
command: rg -q "PitchDetector\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "NoteFollower\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "PitchTrackingTests\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt

checks.name: pitch_detector_yin_api_present
command: rg -q "YIN|yin|d_t|tau|difference" Source/DSP/PitchDetector.h Source/DSP/PitchDetector.cpp && rg -q "confidence|TrackingState|tracking" Source/DSP/PitchDetector.h Source/DSP/PitchDetector.cpp && rg -q "Fifo|FIFO|AbstractFifo|lock.?free|SPSC|ring" Source/DSP/PitchDetector.h Source/DSP/PitchDetector.cpp

checks.name: midi_f0_and_priority_present
command: rg -q "440|69|midi|Midi" Source/DSP/PitchDetector.h Source/DSP/PitchDetector.cpp Source/DSP/NoteFollower.h Source/DSP/NoteFollower.cpp && rg -q "Lowest|Highest|Last|priority|Priority" Source/DSP/PitchDetector.h Source/DSP/PitchDetector.cpp Source/DSP/NoteFollower.h Source/DSP/NoteFollower.cpp

checks.name: note_follower_target_and_smoothing_present
command: rg -q "f_target|harmonic|cents|1200" Source/DSP/NoteFollower.h Source/DSP/NoteFollower.cpp && rg -q "log|ln\(|exp\(|ell|smooth" Source/DSP/NoteFollower.h Source/DSP/NoteFollower.cpp && rg -q "confidence|hold|home|threshold" Source/DSP/NoteFollower.h Source/DSP/NoteFollower.cpp
